gold: Trifascicular block (Right bundle-branch block with alternating left anterior and left posterior fascicular block)

selector.rationale: Evidence of abnormal ECG findings, including bundle-branch block, fascicular block, and axis deviation, supports cardiac conduction disease as the most likely diagnosis.
